limitations: This tool tests against intentionally vulnerable local fixtures only. Findings are preliminary estimates — not confirmed production vulnerabilities. Manual validation by a qualified security professional is required.
scope: Local test lab — 127.0.0.1 only by default.

findings.label: Vulnerable Document Endpoint (BOLA) (object 101)
findings.expected_policy: Only the document owner or admin can access the document.
findings.details: Identity ID 2 accessed object 101 owned by ID 1 and received HTTP 200 with matching ownership evidence in the response body.
findings.remediation: Enforce object-level authorization on every request. Verify that the authenticated user is permitted to access the requested object ID specifically. Never rely on the client to supply authorization context.

findings.label: Vulnerable Admin Endpoint (BFLA)
findings.expected_policy: Only users with 'admin' role can access this endpoint.
findings.details: User with role 'user' accessed /api/admin (required role: 'admin') and received HTTP 200. Response body confirms caller_role vs required_role mismatch.
findings.remediation: Enforce server-side role and permission checks for every sensitive function or administrative endpoint. Deny access explicitly when the caller lacks the required role. Do not rely on UI-level hiding of admin controls.
